description:
Welcome to the SF Ben Insider Podcast; your one-stop-shop for all your Salesforce news, deep dives, and unfiltered discussions, brought to you by the team at Salesforce Ben.

Join your host Ben McCarthy and some great special guests for all the Salesforce insights you find anywhere else.

In this episode, Ben is joined by Robert Sösemann, Salesforce MVP and Principal Architect, to give you the completely unfiltered truth on Agentforce.

Follow us on our socials! 📱
